text:
Implementation progress: compiler foundation and first portable state runtime.

Implemented in the working tree
- Typed independent-layer bindings, heterogeneous category link projections, explicit custom-geom target-lowering adapters with checked index layouts, and row/column/grid/inset interaction composition. Actual layer and KeySpace witnesses prevent label-based joins and root-row casts.
- Optional intaglio-interaction module for JVM and Scala.js depending only on core. Added source key universe to compiled plans so undrawn rows remain selectable without retaining source rows.
- Pure selection/hover/focus/gesture/viewport transitions; disabled/single/multiple modes; replace/add/subtract/toggle/clear; input origin, revision and monotonic sequence checks; projected-input suppression; explicit drop/preserve data reconciliation.
- Typed controller subscriptions preserve entity and category key types from compilation to activation. Idempotent cancellation/disposal, callback-failure reporting, and explicit reentrant-update rejection.
- Module README with verified public example and links from root/documentation; design status now distinguishes current implementation from outstanding work.

Verified locally
- Composition/foundation interaction tests: 40 JVM and 40 Scala.js cases.
- Updated complete core suites: 421 JVM and 416 Scala.js cases before the final additional module-boundary assertion.
- Runtime suites: 20 JVM and 20 Scala.js cases including selection traces, all 64 subset pairs for set laws, source revision/reconciliation fixtures, callback/disposal tests, compile-time subscription key mismatch, and the extracted README example.
- Scala 3.3.8 / Homebrew Java 25.0.1. Supported JDK/Scala matrix, actual browser/native UI, and external-consumer artifact closure are not proven.

Compatibility failure remains open
Ran tools/check-compatibility.sh against the pinned historical baseline. Baseline built successfully; current versionPolicyMimaCheck failed on new core classes in intaglio.interaction and new methods Plot.addPackagedLayer, PlotCompiler.resolveBeforeRetention, PlotLayer.inheritedPackage. Reports are forward-MiMa missing-correspondent errors for additions. Do not call this a passing compatibility gate; TASTy checks later in the alias did not run. No filters, baseline changes, or intention weakening were added to silence these reports. Upstream documents forward MiMa as an approximation; public additions can also affect source name resolution, so review the API boundary and real old-source fixtures before choosing a repair.

Remaining
Child 1 remains doing pending compatibility resolution and final static-render conformance evidence. Child 2 remains doing: the initial runtime is implemented, but visible appearance precedence/focus proof and complete normalized gesture/viewport host contracts remain outstanding. Picking, browser widgets, full linked-view behavior, exports, exact aggregates, algebra/history, measured performance and JavaFX interaction remain in the full epic. Do not mark the goal or either child complete.

Base HEAD: 38e8c62b5b3fb74d0a32664a168e95e9f708bd49. All changes are uncommitted working-tree changes. No commit/push/publication. Exact SHA-256 manifest follows.
